meta.title: Title model
meta.description: Open Plugins → Title model to choose a separate model for the active first-prompt or conversation-following title generator. Save writes the generator’s native provider/model settings; Same as session clears that override. Human prompts used for titles are sent to the selected provider in separate, billable requests. The conversation model, title strategy and user-pinned titles are unchanged. Disabling this settings plugin keeps saved choices; reset them before removing it to restore the session model.
